metadata.title: AI Model Monitoring Metrics
metadata.description: Performance metrics for AI model monitoring including drift, hallucination, latency, and ROI. Since IFC-117 sprint 18 (ADR-088) the values are measured in Grafana Cloud from the OTel instruments ai-worker exports; this file holds targets and configuration only, and every measured field stays null until the production evidence N1-N7 is recorded.

drift_detection.name: Drift Detection Window
drift_detection.description: Time from an output-distribution shift (lead score or confidence) to its detection
drift_detection.measurement_method: Every 30 min, the last 6h of samples are compared with the same 6h slice on days -1..-7: two-sample Kolmogorov-Smirnov (tie-aware, p < 0.01) AND (excess PSI >= 0.1 OR KS D >= 0.1) on 10 fixed bins over [0,1]; a detection needs 3 consecutive detected ticks and is counted at onset and again on each severity escalation of the open event. Minimum 50 reference and 25 current samples, else insufficient_data.

hallucination_rate.name: Hallucination Rate
hallucination_rate.description: Share of lead-scoring outputs the heuristic hallucination checker flags (detected by heuristic checker: a floor, not ground truth)
hallucination_rate.measurement_method: intelliflow_ai_hallucination_detected_total / intelliflow_ai_hallucination_checks_total over the window; reported only with at least 20 checks (alert) or 200 checks (KPI evidence N2).

roi_tracking.name: ROI Tracking (estimated)
roi_tracking.description: Estimated value of AI operations against their LLM cost
roi_tracking.measurement_method: intelliflow_ai_value_estimated_usd_total / intelliflow_ai_cost_usd_total. Value is a fixed estimate per scored lead, not booked revenue; n/a when cost is 0.

latency_slo.name: AI Latency SLO
latency_slo.description: Service Level Objective for AI operation latency
latency_slo.measurement_method: histogram_quantile over intelliflow_ai_inference_latency_milliseconds_bucket (whole monitored chain call, buckets 50ms..30s).

features: Statistical drift detection using KS test
Percentile calculation (P50, P75, P90, P95, P99)
Records inference, cost, estimated value, hallucination and drift through the global OTel meter
Label allowlist (model normalised to known pricing keys, else other)
Runs drift detection every 30 minutes in ai-worker and records each tick

grafana_dashboard.note: Committed, not applied: the dashboard job reads only dashboard-production.json (spec N3).

grafana_alert_rules.note: Applied by CI on merge; routing and series verified by the owner (spec N4, N5).
